div.div:
Source evidence: KL_gptp_engine instantiations, state map, queue arbitration, and public ports.
Teal marks the egress result return: one accepted tuple, held until its own dispatch.
Transmit admission credit is a level; low credit postpones only the three initiating legs.
Dashed marks the serializer-idle dispatch gate; double heads mark return handshakes.
